:::{#def-real-coordinate-space}
#### The set $\reals^p$

For a positive integer $p$,
$\reals^p$ is the set of all
[column vectors](#def-column-vector) of length $p$
whose entries are real numbers.

:::

::: notes
Writing $\vx \in \reals^p$ says, in one symbol,
that $\vx$ is a column vector with $p$ real entries.
In @exr-list-as-vector, $\vx \in \reals^3$.
:::
